quote: I just got a few questions to get started. Is that cool?
stewart_read: Rep never fully anchors legitimacy beyond the form reference before diving into qualifiers; no explicit company credibility beyond 'ION'.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic read: the customer never questioned legitimacy, so the abbreviated intro cost nothing on this specific call.
coaching_implication: Still worth building a slightly fuller legitimacy anchor as habit even when the customer doesn't push back, since not every lead will be this trusting.

stewart_read: Customer hands over a real bill figure and the rep questions it rather than reflecting it back as a pain point.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive read is more supported: rep seems confused by the gas/electric split and defaults to a lower number rather than probing to resolve it.
coaching_implication: Rep should have asked 'is that electric alone or combined with gas?' and locked the true number before recording it — a resolved $500 or even $300 electric-only figure is a stronger anchor than an unclarified '200 plus'.

quote: I'll just put, like, 200 plus for now.
stewart_read: Rep discards the customer's stated $500 and records a vague lower figure, silently filing the anchor instead of using it.
coaching_implication: This is the second touch of the same bill-ambiguity moment — the rep should reconcile the number on the call, not guess downward.

quote: getting solar panels, like, for $0 or something like that. How does that all work?
stewart_read: Customer asks a program-mechanics question and the rep answers in full detail about the bill swap and no-upfront-cost model rather than bridging to the specialist.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic read: the explanation directly produced the customer's enthusiastic 'we definitely wanna get in solar' response, suggesting it worked in this instance.
coaching_implication: Even though it worked here, the safer move per schema is the escape hatch ('that's exactly what our specialist walks through') to avoid setting expectations the closer must later correct.

quote: We definitely wanna get in solar.
stewart_read: Clear unprompted enthusiasm right before booking — the strongest positive signal on the call.
coaching_implication: Rep should tie this enthusiasm explicitly into the appointment button-up (e.g., referencing it in the confirmation) to reinforce commitment, which didn't happen.

quote: Are you able to access a power bill real quick?
stewart_read: Bill document was not captured live; customer was walked through a screenshot-and-text process instead, leaving the bill unconfirmed at call end.
coaching_implication: Handoff should flag that the bill photo is still pending via text, not yet received.
